descriptionHtml:
The Annual General Meeting (AGM) of the IEEE Power and Energy Society was successfully held on 27th December 2025 from 6.00 p.m. to 7.00 p.m. via Zoom. The meeting brought together society members to reflect on the achievements of the past year and to outline the vision and plans for the upcoming term.

During the AGM, important matters such as the presentation of annual reports, financial updates, and the discussion of future activities were addressed. The newly appointed executive committee for the 2025/2026 term was formally introduced, and members were informed about the society’s strategic goals, technical events, and initiatives planned for the year ahead.

The meeting concluded with appreciation expressed to the outgoing committee, advisors, and members for their continued support and active participation. Overall, the AGM marked an important milestone in strengthening the IEEE PES community and reinforcing its commitment to advancing power and energy engineering.
